name: Task Request Management System
description: Build a Task Request Management System (React + Spring Boot + MySQL) with Microsoft OAuth authentication, task/request CRUD operations, user hierarchy (manager/reportees), notifications, file attachments, and dashboard with tabs (Requested By Me, Todos, Reportees). Features: Gmail-like compose popup, due date color coding, approval workflow lifecycle, Microsoft Teams/Azure AD integration via Graph API.

goal.answer: Build a complete Task Request Management System with separate React frontend and Spring Boot backend projects. Microsoft OAuth2 authentication with JWT tokens, user hierarchy via Microsoft Graph API, complete CRUD for task requests, email notifications, file attachments with local storage, dashboard with Requested By Me/Todos/Reportees tabs, Gmail-like compose popup, and due date color coding.

criteria.answer:
Backend: Spring Boot app starts successfully with MySQL connection on port 8080
Backend: OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow login completes and returns JWT token
Backend: All REST API endpoints respond correctly (CRUD for requests, users, attachments)
Frontend: React app runs on port 5173 (Vite dev server)
Frontend: Login page redirects to Microsoft OAuth and returns to dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard displays Requested By Me, Todos, and Reportees tabs
Frontend: New Request compose popup creates requests successfully via API call
Frontend: Due date colors display correctly (red <=2, orange <=5, green >5 days)
Database: All tables created with proper relationships and indexes
File upload: Attachments can be uploaded and retrieved via REST API
Notifications: Email notifications sent when requests are assigned

constraints.answer: Frontend (React/Vite) runs on port 5173, Backend (Spring Boot) runs on port 8080, Must use OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE for Microsoft OAuth, Must use local file system for file storage (not Azure Blob)

phases.answer: Phase 1: Project Structure (backend/ + frontend/), Phase 2: Backend - Security & Authentication, Phase 3: Backend - Entities & Repositories, Phase 4: Backend - Services, REST Controllers & File Upload, Phase 5: Frontend - Core UI & Auth, Phase 6: Frontend - Dashboard Tabs & New Request, Phase 7: Frontend - Due Date Colors & Integration

Verification was limited to compilation and build checks with zero runtime exercise of the backend, API endpoints, file upload, email, or the frontend dev server, so the functionality is completely unproven.
